prompts.prompt: Authentic 16-bit retro pixel art, hard-edge chunky pixel grid, strict palette dithering, coarse visible pixel blocks matching the coarse pixel density of ran-san-moi.webp, completely free of painterly brushwork, no smooth gradients, no digital airbrush, no soft blur, no anime eyes, no chibi. Top-down 3/4 view, warm light from upper left, one dark pixel block outlines for objects. No text, letters, numbers, gridlines, watermark, labels or UI. Source sheet for a 4-column by 5-row crop sprite atlas. Exactly twenty separated individual sprites centered in a regular four by five grid, generous TRUE transparent gutters in both directions, no ground, soil, cast shadow or scenery. Every row must have exactly four separate sprites. Each row progresses from small visible freshly sown seeds in column 1, tiny two-leaf seedling in column 2, developing plant in column 3, to visually unmistakable harvest-ready crop in column 4. Natural size progression is critical: seeds occupy 15% of cell, seedlings 25%, growing 45%, ripe 65%; do not maximize early stage sizes. Assign species in strict top to bottom order: row 1 Vietnamese water spinach (upright slender stems with lance-shaped leaves, mature lush leafy bunch); row 2 carrot (mature feathery greens with exposed orange carrot shoulder and partly visible orange root, no soil); row 3 corn (mature green stalk with bright yellow exposed ear); row 4 pumpkin (mature orange ribbed pumpkin with strong stem and vine); row 5 watermelon (mature dark green striped oval melon on a leafy vine, unlike the pumpkin). Use broad clusters and clearly distinguish mature crops at 48 pixels. Each sprite isolated on true transparent background. Composition strictly taller than wide, 4:5 source sheet.

Top left dry ochre-brown farm soil with short horizontal rows of furrows; top right the same view and same arrangement of furrows in darker damp brown, a few muted cooler damp highlights but no puddles; bottom left muted grass with sparse small blades; bottom right compatible grass with different sparse clusters and tiny leaves. Textures must work as flat repeating terrain on a grid, no defined outline around each square, no visible border, no floating isolated objects, no rim, no perspective foreshortening of each square. Use design similar to Vietnamese retro pixel arcade ground tiles. Square source sheet, exactly four equal square quadrants all filled.
